heroBody: QLED technology offers bright colours, high dynamic range, and superb brightness that holds up in Singapore's tropical climate. The local market features a mix of flagship models from Samsung and Sony as well as more affordable options from LG and other brands. This page pulls live listings from BuyWhere's catalog every few minutes, showing you current floor prices, retailer offers, warranty coverage, and any bundled accessories. By comparing these details you can quickly spot the best value TV for your living room, whether you prioritise gaming performance, movie‑night picture quality, or budget‑friendly options. Shopping for a TV in Singapore often means balancing screen size against room dimensions, and QLED panels excel at maintaining colour accuracy even in bright, sunlit rooms which is common in many HDB flats and condominiums. The latest 2026 models from Samsung and Sony also bring improved processing engines that upscale older content to near-4K quality, making them excellent for streaming services like Netflix and Disney+ which are popular in the region. When looking at the live prices below, pay attention to the retailer type: official mall stores often include extended warranty or installation bundles that third-party sellers might skip.

highlights.title: Brightness & HDR
highlights.body: QLED panels maintain high brightness even in sunny rooms, making HDR content pop on Singapore’s tropical climate. Unlike OLED, there is no risk of burn-in from static news tickers or gaming HUDs.

highlights.title: Colour volume
highlights.body: Quantum Dot filters give richer, more accurate colours compared to traditional LED panels, ideal for streaming 4K HDR services. The 2026 models feature improved blue LEDs for even better colour purity.

highlights.title: Gaming features
highlights.body: Low input lag and HDMI 2.1 support on newer models ensure smooth gameplay on next‑gen consoles. Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) and Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) are now standard on mid-range Samsung and Sony sets.

adviceSectionTitle: How to get the best deal
advicePoints: Watch for major sales periods (9.9, 11.11, 12.12) where retailers slash prices by up to 20%.
Check for bundled accessories like wall‑mounts or streaming sticks that add value.
Prefer authorised Singapore retailers for warranty coverage; parallel imports may be cheaper but lack local service.
Consider screen size vs room size – a 55" TV often offers similar picture quality to a 65" for a lower price.
Use price‑tracking tools; the floor price can dip unexpectedly during flash sales.
Always confirm the 'local set' status if buying from a marketplace seller to ensure your warranty is honoured by the brand in Singapore.

faqs.question: Do QLED TVs have better brightness than OLED?
faqs.answer: In bright environments QLED usually out‑shines OLED due to higher peak brightness, though OLED still leads on true blacks and contrast.

faqs.question: Is the warranty the same for online vs offline stores?
faqs.answer: Authorized online retailers provide the same manufacturer warranty as brick‑and‑mortar stores. Parallel imports may only have seller‑provided warranties.

faqs.question: What screen size is best for a typical Singapore apartment?
faqs.answer: A 55" TV offers a comfortable viewing distance of 2–2.5 m, which fits most living rooms in Singapore apartments. If you have a larger hall, consider a 65" or 75" model.
